on_location_notes: On location; also the Batcave in Batman (1966)
source_notes: Wikipedia says most footage was shot outdoors in Bronson Canyon; AFI Catalog says it was shot entirely on location, in part at the Bronson Caves in Griffith Park; Bronson Canyon article lists the film.

Table point is ~460 m north of the Bronson Caves (OSM 34.12113,-118.31386), up the canyon past the trailhead; borderline on the 500 m threshold, so suggested moving to the cave mouth (the Ro-Man lair). on_location_notes: On location; also Stagecoach (1939) and other John Ford Westerns
source_notes: AFI Catalog (citing Hollywood Reporter production charts): most location shooting was in Monument Valley, with studio work at RKO-Pathé and some scenes in Colorado and Canada (modern sources add Bronson Canyon). True West confirms Monument Valley as the main location.
verification_notes: Point is at the Tribal Park visitor center / The View area, ~1 km from Wikipedia's generic Monument Valley coordinate. Acceptable for a park-level location. Filming was spread across the valley (e.g. John Ford's Point ~3 km south), so this is a representative point, not a single scene spot.

on_location_notes: On location: final cliff scene (Fossil Point area); Rio Grande (1950) also shot around Moab
source_notes: Visit Utah (state tourism / Utah Film Trail): the final scene was filmed at Fossil Point, visible from Dead Horse Point State Park, not at the Grand Canyon. Roadside America and Moab Happenings place 'Thelma and Louise Point' (Fossil Point) on the rim above the Colorado River along Potash Rd / Shafer Trail (BLM/County Rd 142).
verification_notes: Coordinates corrected 2026-10-12. Current point is the Dead Horse Point overlook, the viewpoint rather than the filming spot. OSM has a 'Thelma & Louise Point' node on Shafer Trail at 38.4519,-109.7346, ~2.1 km away and ~400 m lower. That roughly fits a Roadside America visitor's ~2 km viewpoint-to-point distance, though the visitor's direction is muddled. Medium confidence; check on imagery. Keeping the overlook point would also be defensible as 'where you see it from'. movie-locations.com returned HTTP 403.

on_location_notes: On location around Marfa; Reata mansion facade on a ranch west of town (city-level point)
source_notes: AFI Catalog: shot on location at Marfa; the Benedict (Reata) facade was built by Warner Bros., shipped to the Worth Evans Ranch about 21 miles from Marfa, and remains there. Texas Public Radio names the Ryan Ranch west of Marfa instead. Roadside America notes a plywood 'Giant Marfa' tribute ~7 mi west on the north side of US 90.
verification_notes: Coordinates corrected 2026-10-12. Current point (30.2756,-104.0363) is ~4 km south of Marfa, open land with nothing film-related there, so it is not a valid city-level point. Suggested = Marfa town center (Wikipedia; Hotel El Paisano, the cast's base, is at 30.3123,-104.0223). The exact Reata site is on private ranch land along US 90 west (17-21 mi depending on source; Evans vs Ryan ranch conflict) and I could not pin it reliably. movie-locations.com returned HTTP 403.

on_location_notes: Outdoor Western backlot; also Gunfight at the O.K. Corral (1957)
source_notes: Wikipedia film article says exteriors were shot at Old Tucson Studios in summer 1958; Old Tucson article says the production added a saloon, bank and doctor's office to the western street set.
verification_notes: Table point ~170 m from OSM Old Tucson (32.21803,-111.12920) and ~230 m from Wikipedia coords; inside the studio grounds.

on_location_notes: On location: opening scene at the storefront
source_notes: NYC-in-film guide and the Museum of the City of New York mapping project both put the opening (Holly eating pastry at the window) outside Tiffany's at 727 Fifth Ave / 57th St, shot early on a Sunday morning; store interiors were built on a Paramount soundstage.
verification_notes: Point is at the 5th Ave/57th St corner storefront (~30 m). The MCNY page apparently lists a wrong address (610 5th Ave); the search summary showed that and I did not open the page myself. Only the exterior was filmed here.

on_location_notes: On location throughout Hoboken
source_notes: Hoboken Girl history piece says the park scenes were filmed in Elysian Park and Church Square Park; LatLong's location list includes Elysian Park (~40.748375,-74.025520) among Hoboken shooting sites.
verification_notes: Table point is ~70 m from OSM Elysian Park centroid (40.74876,-74.02576). Evidence is weaker than for other rows: no AFI/official source found naming Elysian Park specifically (Hoboken overall is well documented as a 36-day location shoot); Church Square Park is also cited for park scenes.

source_notes: AFI Catalog: the Park Service allowed only establishing shots of the monument and the balcony outside the tourist cafeteria; every shot on or around the faces, plus Vandamm's house, was done at MGM with sets and matte paintings. verification_notes: Coordinates corrected 2026-10-12. Current point (43.8981,-103.4845) is ~3.3 km NW of the visitor area, in forest. The suggested point is Grand View Terrace (OSM), next to today's concession/cafe building and the closest match to the 1958 cafeteria and terrace (the original building has been replaced). PARTIAL on-location status confirmed. hitchcock.zone failed: the URL now serves unrelated spam content. The NPS URL is the park home page and was not fetched to back the filming claim.

film: Close Encounters of the Third Kind
on_location_notes: On location: exteriors at the tower (now the KOA); landing-site set was in Mobile, AL
source_notes: Cowboy State Daily (interview with Sen. Ogden Driskill): the Park Service would not allow the main filming inside the monument, so Spielberg paid the Driskill family to shoot on their ranch next door, which later became the Devils Tower KOA. The Boston Globe also says the KOA stands on the filming land.
verification_notes: Point (44.5893,-104.6995) falls inside the OSM Devils Tower KOA polygon at the tower's base, ~1.2 km east of the summit. This matches the on-location exteriors. The main landing-site set was in a hangar in Mobile, AL.

on_location_notes: On location: exteriors and many interiors
source_notes: Roadside America and the Lincoln Highway Guide describe the closed Mansfield reformatory as the main prison location (exteriors plus some interiors, shot in 1993); other scenes were filmed around Mansfield, Malabar Farm, Upper Sandusky and nearby towns.
verification_notes: ~250 m from the Wikipedia coordinate (40.7853,-82.5050). It sits on the reformatory grounds by the administration building. The lincolnhighwayguide.com URL gave HTTP 406 when fetched directly but appeared in search results. Most of the prison yard has been demolished since.

verification_notes: Table point is ~140 m SW of the square centroid (32.07584,-81.09314); within threshold, though the bench was on the north side (~32.0762,-81.0932) if a tighter point is wanted.

on_location_notes: On location: the training run up the steps
source_notes: Wikipedia (Rocky Steps) says the training run was filmed on the 72 east-entrance steps of the Philadelphia Museum of Art and was an early Steadicam shot; a 6abc/WPVI piece has inventor Garrett Brown describing his Steadicam work on the steps.
verification_notes: ~100 m from Wikipedia's Rocky Steps coordinate (39.9649,-75.1802). Within tolerance.

on_location_notes: On location around Edgartown and the island (city-level point)
source_notes: The Daily Jaws lists Edgartown Main Street, Town Hall (town meeting), the police station and hardware store, harbor and Chappy Ferry as Amity locations; Atlas of Wonders places the downtown sites on Main St / South Water St within walking distance; ASC article covers the Martha's Vineyard location shoot.

Table point (upper Main St area) is ~440 m from Edgartown Town Hall (41.38983,-70.51478) and ~500 m from the Port Hunter/old hardware store (41.38989,-70.51394); suggested a point on Main St between those two, the core of the downtown Amity filming cluster.

film: Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid
on_location_notes: On location: the bicycle scene
source_notes: Islands.com and Roadside America say the bicycle / 'Raindrops' scene was shot at Grafton ghost town near Zion (late 1960s, reportedly Oct 1968), with the schoolhouse and the Alonzo Russell home in the background.
verification_notes: Matches Wikipedia (37.1672,-113.0800) within ~150 m, at the schoolhouse/townsite.

location_name: North Fork Store ("Grace's Diner"), Highway 75 north of Ketchum
on_location_notes: The roadside North Fork Store was dressed as Grace's Diner; the snowbound bus-stop exteriors with Marilyn Monroe were shot here in early 1956.
source_notes: AFI (Bus Stop): diner exteriors shot at Sun Valley, rodeo filmed in Phoenix. Idaho Mountain Express: the North Fork Store on Hwy 75 was rebranded Grace's Diner for the film, then relocated north of Ketchum. AFI (Sun Valley Serenade): only unspecified parts filmed at Sun Valley.
verification_notes: corrected: Swapped from Sun Valley Serenade (1941). AFI does say parts of Serenade were shot at Sun Valley, but that was second-unit ski footage on unnamed slopes, mixed with studio rear projection, so there is no specific spot to pin. Bus Stop has a documented outdoor site (North Fork Store), confirmed by AFI and local press. Coordinates are approximate to the junction. Coordinates: Approximate: Highway 75 at the North Fork Canyon Rd junction by the Sawtooth NRA headquarters (OSM/Nominatim, HQ at 43.78739,-114.42129), ~8 mi north of Ketchum. The store's exact original lot is not published, and the building was moved in 2019.

location_name: Kelly Warm Springs / Gros Ventre Road near Kelly (Starrett homestead site), Jackson Hole
on_location_notes: The Starrett homestead and the Grafton town set stood on the sagebrush flats near Kelly with the Tetons behind; the Luther Taylor 'Shane cabin' nearby appears briefly.
source_notes: Wikipedia: the town and Starrett homestead sets were built near Kelly, Jackson Hole, and later razed. American Cowboy: the town set was on Antelope Flats and homestead exteriors were at Kelly Warm Springs. NPS: the Luther Taylor cabin on Gros Ventre Rd is known as the 'Shane cabin'.
verification_notes: verified: Outdoor filming in the Kelly/Antelope Flats area is well supported (AFI also lists Menor's Ferry). The point marks the homestead area. The town set site on Antelope Flats has no published coordinates. Sources disagree on whether the surviving cabin was Taylor's or 'Ernie Wright's'. Coordinates: OSM/Nominatim coordinates of Kelly Warm Springs (hot spring feature), which American Cowboy names as the homestead exterior site. The surviving Luther Taylor 'Shane cabin' is a short way east on Gros Ventre Rd per NPS, but its exact coordinates are unpublished.

location_name: Gallatin River below Storm Castle Peak (Squaw Creek Bridge), Gallatin Canyon
on_location_notes: The Gallatin Canyon stood in for the Big Blackfoot; the fly-fishing scenes among the boulders were shot here, with Storm Castle Peak as a backdrop.
image_credit: Wikimedia Commons · CC BY-SA 2.0 · Jim from Lexington, KY, USA
source_notes: AFI: the Gallatin River replaced the Big Blackfoot, which logging had degraded. Visit Big Sky: the fishing scenes show Gallatin Canyon landmarks such as Storm Castle peak. Wikipedia: parts of the film were shot on the Gallatin River.
verification_notes: verified: The location is correct, but the canyon is a better pin than 'near Bozeman'. The specific bend used is not documented; a lodge near Storm Castle and a Gallatin Gateway property both claim it in marketing copy. Some scenes also used the Boulder, Yellowstone, and Madison rivers, with Livingston as the town. Coordinates: OSM bridge feature (GNIS 1737921), Squaw Creek Bridge over the Gallatin River, about 2 km from Storm Castle Peak (OSM 45.44988,-111.22422). It stands in for the Storm Castle stretch because exact camera spots are unpublished.

on_location_notes: Aerial and establishing shots of the lodge's exterior stand in for the Overlook Hotel; the interiors, hedge maze, and full exterior set were built at Elstree in England.
image_credit: Wikimedia Commons · CC BY-SA 3.0 · Kelvin Kay
source_notes: Wikipedia: Timberline Lodge was filmed for a few Overlook exterior establishing shots, while most of the film was shot at Elstree. Roadtrippers, citing the lodge's site: aerial and exterior footage of the lodge was used, while the maze and other exteriors were filmed in England.
verification_notes: verified: The real exterior was shot on location, but only for establishing shots; the hedge maze and close exterior scenes are studio sets. Coordinates: OSM/Nominatim coordinates of the Timberline Lodge building, which agree with the Commons photo GPS (45.331111,-121.71) and Wikipedia.

location_name: Wild Goose Island Overlook, Going-to-the-Sun Road, St. Mary Lake, Glacier NP
on_location_notes: In the opening titles, a helicopter sweeps over St. Mary Lake past Wild Goose Island, then trails the Torrances' VW Beetle along Going-to-the-Sun Road.
image_credit: Wikimedia Commons · Public domain · David Restivo, NPS
source_notes: Wikipedia: the opening aerials were shot over Saint Mary Lake and Wild Goose Island, and the car drives Going-to-the-Sun Road. Idyllopus (a location-matching fan site): identifies the Wild Goose Island opening shot and the road's West Tunnel. MyHikes: overlook coordinates.
verification_notes: verified: Real outdoor second-unit aerial footage. The drive covers many miles of road, so the overlook is a representative point; later shots include the West Tunnel near Logan Pass. No official NPS page was found. Coordinates: Coordinates of the Wild Goose Island viewpoint from MyHikes, which match the OSM viewpoint and parking nodes (48.69175,-113.53134). Wild Goose Island itself is at OSM 48.68893,-113.54042.

on_location_notes: The beach chase, where the Fratellis lose police in an off-road rally, was shot on the sand below Haystack Rock; the kids also use the rock as a landmark when reading the map.
source_notes: Wikipedia and Oregon Encyclopedia place the off-road beach chase at Haystack Rock and the map/landmark sequence at Ecola State Park overlooking Cannon Beach.
verification_notes: verified: Haystack Rock outdoor filming confirmed. Note: the finale on the beach was shot at Goat Rock/Bodega Bay, CA, and the pirate ship was a Burbank soundstage set, so don't credit those to Cannon Beach. Alternative row: Walsh house, 368 38th St, Astoria (46.19288, -123.79963), but the street is closed to visitors since 2015. Coordinates: OpenStreetMap/Nominatim islet feature 'Haystack Rock, Clatsop County' (45.8844525, -123.9684037), rounded to 5 decimals.

on_location_notes: Brownsville's historic Main Street stood in for Castle Rock: Gordie and Chris run into Ace's gang outside the saloon, and the boys split up at the end near Park Avenue.
image_credit: Wikimedia Commons · CC BY 2.0 · Bruce Fingerhood
source_notes: Oregon Film Trail, Roadside America and IMDb agree Brownsville played Castle Rock, naming Main St storefronts, the saloon at 419 N Main, Pioneer Park (pie contest) and the Calapooia bridge.
verification_notes: verified: Solid. The famous railroad trestle is NOT in Brownsville (Lake Britton, near Burney, CA); keep it out of this row. Pioneer Park (44.39205, -122.98886) is an alternative spot for the pie-eating scene. Coordinates: OpenStreetMap/Nominatim address point for 419 N Main St, Brownsville (Brownsville Saloon, listed by IMDb/fan guides as a Castle Rock location); Main St/Park Ave intersection is ~120 m south at 44.39352, -122.98443.

location_name: Sleepless in Seattle houseboat, 2460 Westlake Ave N, Lake Union
on_location_notes: The exterior of Sam and Jonah's floating home was filmed at a real houseboat at the end of a dock on Lake Union's west shore; it is still a private residence.
image_credit: Wikimedia Commons · CC BY 2.0 · Brian Teutsch
source_notes: Location blogs and a 2008 HeraldNet sale report identify the real Lake Union floating home off Westlake Ave N used for the film; interiors were remodeled later.
verification_notes: verified: Real house used for exteriors; many interior scenes were reportedly shot on sets. The 2460 address is widely cited (tours, OSM) but I did not find a press or official source naming it, so the address is moderately confident. Coordinates: OpenStreetMap/Nominatim house node for 2460 Westlake Ave N (47.6410886, -122.3407265), the dock-end floating home; the geotag on the Commons photo (47.64012, -122.34105) is the photographer's spot on the water.

location_name: Fort Worden parade ground, Port Townsend
on_location_notes: The former Army post at Fort Worden played the Navy flight school, with drills on the parade ground and scenes at the beach, gun batteries and the USO hall.
image_credit: Wikimedia Commons · CC BY-SA 3.0 · Joe Mabel
source_notes: Wikipedia, HistoryLink and the AFI Catalog say the film was shot in spring 1981 at Port Townsend, with Fort Worden standing in for the Pensacola officer school since the Navy refused access.
verification_notes: verified: Strongly documented. Other Port Townsend spots: Tides Inn motel on Water St, and the paper mill for the final scene. USO building in OSM at 48.13480, -122.77011. Coordinates: OpenStreetMap 'Parade Ground' feature in Fort Worden Historical State Park via Overpass (48.1333815, -122.7659498).

location_name: Deb's (Katie's) Meadow near Owl Creek Pass
on_location_notes: Rooster Cogburn's charge with the reins in his teeth against Ned Pepper's gang was shot in this aspen-ringed meadow, with Chimney Rock in the background.
source_notes: Ridgway tourism and the Colorado Springs Gazette place the shootout at Deb's Meadow near Owl Creek Pass; the AFI Catalog confirms location work around Ridgway and Montrose, CO.
verification_notes: verified: Meadow name varies (Deb's, Debbie's, Katie's). Image is a PD studio publicity still (Wayne and Darby), not necessarily taken at the meadow. Alternative: Hartwell Park in Ridgway, site of the hanging scene. Coordinates: Coordinates published by the Town of Ridgway tourism site for Katie's/Deb's Meadow (38.162455, -107.569270); consistent with its position just NW of Owl Creek Pass. Not independently checked against imagery.

film: Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid
location_name: Rockwood Cut, Durango & Silverton Narrow Gauge Railroad
on_location_notes: The gang's train robberies were shot on the narrow-gauge line north of Durango; at the Rockwood Cut, Butch boards a coach and works his way forward to the engine.
image_credit: Wikimedia Commons · CC BY 2.0 · Mark Goebel
source_notes: IMTDb lists all train scenes as shot on the D&RGW (now D&SNG) line, with the first robbery at Rockwood Cut; Durango Herald confirms the rooftop train scenes on the D&SNG and the Baker's Bridge jump nearby.
verification_notes: verified: Train robbery filming on the D&SNG is well attested. Pinned to Rockwood Cut, the one spot a source names. The cliff jump was set at Baker's Bridge (about 5 km north); the actual plunge was done by stuntmen in California. Some sources also say parts of the opening were shot in Utah. Coordinates: DMS coordinates for the Rockwood Cut (37°29'26.9"N 107°47'38.6"W) from the Internet Movie Trains Database page, converted to decimal; matches the rock cut on the D&SNG just north of the Rockwood depot (OSM Rockwood hamlet 37.4908, -107.8020).

on_location_notes: The climactic mustang roundup, with Gable roping horses from a truck and plane, was filmed on this playa east of Dayton; the dry lake was later named after the film.
source_notes: Wikipedia (citing Goode's 'The Making of the Misfits' and Nevada state archivist Guy Rocha) places the roundup on a dry lake about 12 miles east of Dayton near Stagecoach, now GNIS 'Misfits Flat'; HCN describes the site today.
verification_notes: corrected: The roundup was not at Dayton or Pyramid Lake. It was filmed at Misfits Flat, about 12 mi east of Dayton. Dayton was used for the bar and rodeo scenes, and Quail Canyon near Pyramid Lake for other exteriors. Image is a public-domain trailer still of the cast, not the roundup. Coordinates: USGS GNIS feature 850743 'Misfits Flat' (Lyon County, NV), queried from the National Map geonames service; midpoint of the two GNIS points (39.34020,-119.38351 and 39.33655,-119.37399).

location_name: Exterior cliff-dwelling set west of Gallup
on_location_notes: Paramount built a huge exterior set with a fake cliff dwelling, collapsed cave and carnival grounds in the desert west of Gallup; cave interiors were shot on a Hollywood stage.
source_notes: AFI Catalog says location filming took place about 15 miles west of Gallup, where the cliff-dwelling set was built, with over a thousand local extras; Wikipedia says 19 miles west, gives set dimensions and coordinates, and notes the underground scenes were shot at Paramount.
verification_notes: verified: The exterior set was built and filmed on location near Gallup. The cliff dwelling was a constructed set, not a real ruin. The distance differs by source (AFI 15 mi, Wikipedia 19 mi), and the coordinates come from Wikipedia without a separate source, so treat the point as approximate. Coordinates: Coordinates given for the exterior set in the Wikipedia article (35°23'49"N 109°01'09"W), converted to decimal. Approximate: the set no longer exists and its exact footprint is not independently confirmed.

location_name: Las Vegas Plaza (Old Town), Las Vegas
on_location_notes: Wyatt and Billy ride into a small-town parade around the plaza, get arrested for parading without a permit, and meet Jack Nicholson's George Hanson in the town jail.
source_notes: AFI Catalog cites a June 1968 LA Times item reporting the parade sequence was shot in Las Vegas, NM, and Variety noting Taos location work; Wikipedia says the commune was a recreated set in Malibu Canyon, CA.
verification_notes: corrected: The commune was not filmed near Taos: New Buffalo commune refused permission, so it was rebuilt on Piuma Canyon Rd above Malibu Canyon, CA. AFI confirms some Taos-area shooting but names no site, and no source found ties a scene to Taos Pueblo. Replaced with the well-documented Las Vegas, NM parade/jail sequence. The plaza is pinned from fan guides, not an official source. Coordinates: OpenStreetMap/Nominatim centroid of Plaza Park, Bridge Street Historic District, Las Vegas, NM (the plaza where fan location guides place the parade).

location_name: Dantes View, Death Valley National Park
on_location_notes: Luke and Obi-Wan's first view of Mos Eisley was shot from this overlook, with the spaceport matte-painted in; Artists Palette and Desolation Canyon nearby were also used.
image_credit: Wikimedia Commons · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Christian David
source_notes: An NPS news release notes Dantes View was used in the 1977 Star Wars; Saturday Evening Post lists the park's A New Hope sites (Dantes View as the Mos Eisley overlook, Artists Palette for R2's Jawa capture, Desolation Canyon for the Tusken/bantha shots); Wikipedia notes the matte painting.
verification_notes: verified: Death Valley pickup shots for A New Hope are well documented. Dantes View was chosen as the single point. Some accounts say the Mos Eisley overlook combines a Dantes View plate with footage from Tunisia. Twenty Mule Team Canyon belongs to Return of the Jedi, not 1977. Coordinates: OpenStreetMap viewpoint node 'Dante's View' via Nominatim (36.22066, -116.72675); agrees with Wikipedia's 36.2206, -116.7264.

location_name: Cheatham Grove, Grizzly Creek Redwoods State Park (Humboldt County)
on_location_notes: The forest-moon speeder bike chase was shot among the old-growth redwoods of this grove beside Hwy 36. It is the only major Endor site still standing uncut.
image_credit: Wikimedia Commons · CC BY 2.0 · Jason Hollinger
source_notes: Multiple sources place the speeder chase at Cheatham (Chetham) Grove; Ewok village/battle shot on private Miller-Rellim logging land near Smith River, since clear-cut.
verification_notes: corrected: Jedediah Smith Redwoods SP is a commonly repeated but disputed claim. The Del Norte shoot was on private Miller-Rellim timber land off Morrison Creek Rd near Smith River, since logged, so no precise surviving spot. Swapped to the verified, intact Cheatham Grove. Coordinates: OpenStreetMap Nominatim: 'Cheatham Grove trail' path feature, Grizzly Creek Redwoods SP (~3 mi west of park HQ at 40.48528,-123.90611 per Wikipedia).

location_name: Alstrom Point, Lake Powell (Glen Canyon NRA)
on_location_notes: Lake Powell stood in for the alien world where the astronauts' ship sinks; the crash shot looks out from Alstrom Point toward Gunsight Butte before the crew's desert trek.
image_credit: Wikimedia Commons · CC BY 2.0 · The Greater Southwestern Exploration Company
source_notes: Wikipedia: desert sequences shot around Lake Powell/Glen Canyon and Page, AZ; Salt Lake Tribune ties the crash/life-raft scene to Alstrom Point with Gunsight Butte behind.
verification_notes: verified: Lake Powell area is well supported. Exact crash spot: the Tribune and Wikipedia's Alstrom Point article say Alstrom Point; one blog cites the script naming Lone Rock. The trek scenes were spread across Glen Canyon and near Page, AZ. Coordinates: OpenStreetMap Nominatim tourism=viewpoint 'Alstrom Point' (matches Wikipedia 37.0589,-111.3646).

film: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
on_location_notes: In the 1912 prologue, young Indy's Scout troop rides beneath Double Arch to reach a cave. The arch is real, but the cave was a movie invention.
source_notes: Wikipedia and the Natural Arch and Bridge Society both document Double Arch as the backdrop for the film's opening, and both note the cave is fictional.
verification_notes: verified: Solid. Other parts of the prologue (the circus-train chase) were filmed elsewhere in the Moab/Cisco area, not at Double Arch. Coordinates: OpenStreetMap natural=arch node 'Double Arch' (Wikipedia gives 38.69165,-109.54067).

location_name: Forrest Gump Point, US-163 near Monument Valley
on_location_notes: Forrest ends his cross-country run here, on the highway with Monument Valley's buttes behind him, and tells his followers he's going home.
image_credit: Wikimedia Commons · CC BY-SA 4.0 · King of Hearts
source_notes: Visit Utah (state tourism office) and Roadside America identify the US-163 pullout near milepost 13 as where Forrest stops running.
verification_notes: verified: Well established. The viewpoint is in San Juan County, UT, just north of the Arizona line. Coordinates: OpenStreetMap tourism=viewpoint 'Forrest Gump Point' on US 163 (agrees with published 37.101445,-109.990812); near milepost 13.

on_location_notes: This working 1906 flour mill was where Ren has his job in the film. It looks almost unchanged today, and dance scenes were filmed inside.
image_credit: Wikimedia Commons · CC BY-SA 4.0 · An Errant Knight
source_notes: Utah Film Commission lists Lehi Roller Mills among the key locations; FOX 13 and ABC4 describe it as Ren's workplace.
verification_notes: verified: Picked the mill over Payson High School because it is a recognizable exterior that still stands; the old Payson HS building was slated for demolition in 2025. Sources disagree on where the prom finale was shot (Payson HS vs. a set), so the notes leave it out. Coordinates: OpenStreetMap Nominatim building feature 'Lehi Roller Mills', 833 E Main St, Lehi.
